text:
What is the best method to demagnetise a steel rod?
A
Pass the rod through a coil connected to an a.c. supply.
B
Pass the rod through a coil connected to a d.c. supply.
C
Place the rod next to another magnet.
D
Stroke the rod with another magnet.

options.label: A
options.text: Pass the rod through a coil connected to an a.c. supply.

options.label: B
options.text: Pass the rod through a coil connected to a d.c. supply.

options.label: C
options.text: Place the rod next to another magnet.

options.label: D
options.text: Stroke the rod with another magnet.
